test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Some reasons highlighting the importance of delivering sex education in schools are mentioned below.

Choose the incorrect option.

options.text: Knowing about their body changes, teenagers start making fun of each other
Helps to keep teenagers away from sexual abuse
Knowledge about changes taking place during puberty

solution:
The incorrect answer is **'__Knowing about their body changes, teenagers start making fun of each other__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Sex education:**

 
• Sex education is an** educational principle that raises awareness about various sexual changes and processes** in the body.
 
• Its goal is to raise awareness about** sexually transmitted diseases , safe sex practices and sexual abuse**.
 
• Knowledge about changes taking place during puberty.
 
• Sex education is essential in schools because it** informs students about reproductive health, related organs, adolescence, and sexually transmitted diseases.**
 
• It also **raises awareness** in order to protect people from** misconceptions about various sex-related issue**s.
 
• **Discouraging various myths and misconceptions **among youth.
